Name: Simple page - one screen
Notes: The page is right as it opens: one screenshot of what fits on the screen.

Name: Long list - whole page
Notes: Y captures the whole page as one screenshot per screenful - for user lists and logs.

Name: Click a tab by its words
Notes: Opens the page then clicks the tab or link showing these words (capital letters do not matter).

Name: Two clicks in a row
Notes: Steps run left to right; separate them with a semicolon.

Name: Slow page - wait first
Notes: Waits 5 seconds for the page to fill in before the screenshot. 2.5 and 2

Name: Click then wait then capture all
Notes: Clicks a tab then waits for the table to load then captures the whole page.

Name: Click an exact element (selector)
Notes: For when the same words appear twice: click: followed by a selector copied from Edge (F12 then right-click then Copy selector).

Name: Notes with commas
Notes: Put text that contains commas, like this one, in double quotes.

Name: Control reference in the notes
Notes: ITGC-07 - firewall rules reviewed quarterly; check the last-modified date column.

Name: Page reached through a menu
Notes: Start from a page you can open directly then click through the menu to the evidence.
